balls.text: drills it back so hard and straight, that has struck the stumps in front of the umpire and all they'll get for that middled stroke is a single

short ball outside off, Rinku loves pace on the ball and he uses the 128kmh on this ball to dispatch that over the midwicket boundary. The crowd erupted as soon as they heard the cracking sound off the bat
118.4kmh, slow and wide, he chases that and connects but finds cover
towards the stumps and he gets a single to deep square

the slow offcutter does it for Kuldeep! Full and just outside off, he goes after that and it's gone pretty high, Dhruv Jurel runs back from the circle and dives to his left to complete an excellent catch

smacked to Riyan Parag at long-on. He has taken that with a leap, but the momentum has pushed him over the boundary and he has done very well to throw the ball inside just in time! He dropped a sitter at the start of the match and kind of finishes the innings with a stunning effort
misses the yorker wide outside off by a small margin and this time Venkatesh slices it away square on the off side in the gap for four
a good reply from Avesh. Sends this down at 139.6kmh just outside off in the block hole, Venkatesh charges and misses the swing
goes for the short of length ball outside off and Rinku smacks it to cover for one
backs away, Avesh goes for the wide yorker but it's almost a half-volley and Rinku scythes that wide of short third. Gets the placement he wanted for four
into the pitch on middle from wide of the crease, Rinku makes room and slashes that flat over the covers for a six! Connected really well for that
a yorker just outside off and he bunts it down to long-off for one
and he finishes it out nicely. Gets the yorker right just outside off as Rinku makes room and then tries to reach out for it but misses. Who says Boult is poor in the death overs?
outside off now and he pushes it to mid-off for one
goes for the yorker again, and Venkatesh charges down to make it a full toss and get a couple to long-on

nails the yorker and that's the end of Narine! Swinging into the stumps, beats the bat and that knocks over leg stump in spectacular fashion. Boult goes over to shake Narine's hand immediately because he has played the knock of his life
puts the pace back in it, brings it closer to the batter and Narine doesn't mind it at all. Middles that pull this time and beats deep midwicket
starts with a slow bouncer just outside off, Narine pulls and misses
ends the over with a slower short ball and Narine swats it away to leg for one and keeps strike
just misses the wide yorker, Narine pounces on the half-volley and slices that along the ground, just beats the diving short third fielder for four more!
much closer to Narine with a slightly wide yorker, he misses this time
a dipping full toss outside off with pace, 137.5kmh, Narine lets it go
129.5kmh, short ball angled into Narine and he ducks under it. Called a wide
edges the first ball from outside off to deep third. They have to settle for one
slower one at 119.2kmh, pretty wide and Russell throws his bat at it but it's the lack of pace that ensures the ball only reaches the fielder at deep third

he's got it! Pulled to the midwicket boundary and Russell sprints across for a bear hug like no other! Just 49 balls, non-stop hitting, fair bit of luck, 11 fours and six sixes, and he has taken down arguably the best bowling attack of this IPL in dominating fashion. Shahrukh Khan is all applause, Gambhir comes out to hug Narine too, because it's a time out
that is poor and predictable bowling and Narine is feasting on it! Flat and wide outside off, Narine again stays back and smokes it back with a flat bat for his sixth six!
slows it down a fair bit well outside off, left for a wide
much shorter and flatter outside off, Narine rocks back quickly and slaps that straight over the bowler's head for a one-bounce four! Chahal can't help but smile after that
dances down, takes that legbreak on the full and that's landed among the flags over long-off! Narine is dominating the spinners, as usual
flat and into the stumps, Russell patiently works it past midwicket for one
on length outside off without much room, Narine slog sweeps but only manages an edge for one to leg

doesn't nail the wide yorker but Russell nails the shot! Low and wide full toss, Russell goes low in the crease and stretches out towards the ball to scythe that all along the ground between backward point and deep third for four!
short ball into the body and Narine pulls it to leg for one
the luck continues for Narine! Not a bad ball, really, length outside off. The mistake was it had width which made Narine go after it and he got a leading edge that flew over short third
pretty wide again, might have been called a wide, but Russell hammers it to deep cover for one
lines up for a big shot, Kuldeep bowls a wide yorker beyond the wide line
much shorter, enough room on the off side and Russell backs away just a little to smack that square, nearly for a flat six! Stunning connection
moves that away from the batter well outside off and Russell swings hard and misses
goes wide just before delivering and that's swung into Russell too, he defends patiently. He'll go after the other bowlers
beats him comprehensively with a quicker delivery that swung into the batter and he was caught perplexed. Just managed to get bat on it
length ball on leg and it's gone straight to short fine leg
turning into Russell around middle, he nudges it fine on the leg side for two
that was going wide of the tram line again outside off, but Narine goes after it and slices another into the air. Luckily for him again, it lands well before the fielder
on the leg side now, he has over-compensated that and it's gone past the pads and the keeper for five wides
very wide outside off again, Narine hardly moves this time and that's surely a wide
Narine charges down and Ashwin pitches it pretty wide outside off, Narine has to go after it and slices it in the air towards deep point. They return for two
guess what, he starts with a wide which is full and right on the tram line outside off

Chahal has got Shreyas now, at least for now! Given out on the field, Shreyas seemed ot have walked initially but has reviewed it. He went down on a knee for a slog-sweep but missed the ball and was hit on the back leg right in front off middle. No bat there, Shreyas has started to walk before seeing ball-tracking on the big screen, because it later shows it's hitting middle
Shreyas joins the six-hitting party now! A slider on the stumps, pitched up, and Shreyas smacks it well over the long-on fielder who can only watch it sail over him for six
fuller around off and it's driven straight to cover
beats him with a beauty! Quick legbreak around off, Shreyas pokes quickly but the turn beats him
slightly short and Narine pulls it with a pivot to deep midwicket
loopy on middle and he clips it to leg for a single

and a boundary to end the over! Narine has won this battle tonight, even if he gets out to Ashwin later. Width again, there's a fielder at deep cover so Narine sends that crashing straight down to the long-off boundary for the second four of the over after a six
another wide delivery but just inside the line again. Not a wide after it's left alone
outside off, teasing him with the width and left alone. Not a wide
outside off, on length, and Narine smokes it back over the bowler's head again. This one doesn't have the height but it has the pace to beat long-off

cracking shot down the ground! Narine is dominating Ashwin here and Ashwin has had no answer yet. Slightly wide again, enough room for Narine to give it a big swing and land the ball into the home crowd for his fourth six
keeps the line well outside off again, just inside the tram line this time
another wide well outside off to Narine

excellent placement! Almost like Raghuvanshi hit that one. Shreyas went across in the crease towards off and sliced that wide half-volley all along the ground, using the pace of the ball, to the deep-third boundary for four
quick and back of length into the batter, Shreyas hops and defends it to off

straight to deep third! Finally some relief for Royals. Raghuvanshi has done his job though. He went after the short ball outside off with an upper square cut and kind of middled it too, but couldn't clear the fielder
a short ball into the body now and Narine keeps going. Pulls it in the air and it lands well short of the fielder in the deep
angling away just outside off, it's pretty short and the angle gives him the room to slash it away with a big horizontal swing to send that crashing into the covers boundary
a short ball outside off now, and Narine swings and misses on this occasion
starts with a short ball down leg and called a wide
full toss on the pads and he sends that to deep midwicket for one

third six for Narine tonight and that brings up his fifty off 29 balls! Another one over long-off as Ashwin pitches it up, it sails into the stands, Narine raises his bat to point it to the dressing room which is all applauding for him

pretty wide full toss outside off, Narine doesn't move his feet at all while chasing that and it's called a wide. Ashwin has convinced Samson to review it. Narine didn't move in his stance there, and the ball was wide of the tram line. Review burnt
turning into middle from off and Raghuvanshi works it to deep square again
width again, that looks like the plan from Ashwin with protection in the deep at cover, and Narine places it there for one
goes after that one well outside off and gets an inside edge onto his pads
on length on leg and he clips it to deep square for one
smoked over long-off! That's in the slot from Chahal, a half-volley around off and Narine pounced on it like a dog on a treat to middle that down the ground
77.3kmh, really slow and pretty wide outside off. Narine has all the time to hang back and punch it wide of cover, and this time Parag does well with his slide to his right and save two
a loopy legbreak on middle, Raghuvanshi waits for it and flicks it against the turn to long-on again
swings the really wide length ball over Chahal to long-on for one
leans forward and pushes the length ball to cover for a quick single
goes straight after pitching outside off and Raghuvanshi chops it so late in the crease to send that rolling along the carpet and beat short third for four. Great timing from the tall man again
tries the reverse on the last ball and Ashwin bowls it flat outside off to beat Narine
just wide of backward point now! Slower and still quite wide to make Narine go after it, he slices it to backward point where Avesh dives to his left, not very elegantly, and that goes for four too

smashed into the cover boundary and just beats Jaiswal out there! Ashwin pitched it wide because he had a fielder for that shot there. Narine swung his arms for it and the ball landed just wide of the fielder in the deep
fairly flat and wide outside off, he lets it go
turning into the batter around middle, he works it away to long-on for one
starts with a wide full toss drifting in and Narine whacks it down to long-on
flicks the last ball with the spin off the pads for one
leans into the legbreak and gets a single to long-off

slightly poor fielding at long-on and Parag has leaked a boundary! Slower through the air on middle, and Raghuvanshi placed it beautifully wide of long-on with a forward lean. Parag gave it a chase, a slide in the end but the ball went through him
beats him on the first ball by pitching it on leg, fairly flat, and Narine maybe got an edge on his pad for a single
similar but a touch fuller and he flicks it away to long-on for one
starts with a legbreak on middle which is pushed to cover
stylish shot to end the powerplay! Around length on leg and Narine backs away to free his arms with a swing down the ground over the bowler's head for four

that has touched the moon and then landed in the stands at Eden! Not a horrible short ball but Narine went for the pull and finally connected with one and how! Middled the daylights out of it for a cracking six over deep midwicket
outswing for the short ball outside off, and Raghuvanshi gets the toe end while trying to slash it away. Single to deep third
140.5kmh, back of length outside off and he crunches it straight to point
he gets one outside off with a hint of width and sends that in the air to deep point after a bounce
short ball down the leg side, Narine doesn't make room this time and that deflects off his hip to go very fine on leg and beat Samson's dive for four leg byes

a bit too full and this time it's an exquisite drive through the covers! Raghuvanshi is showing some class here with his timing and placement. Enough width outside off and he opens his arms for a wonderful drive all along the ground again
threads the gap behind square for four! Excellent placement from Raghuvanshi. Full and wide and he opens the face of the bat in time to bisect the gap between point and short third
139.2kmh, miscues the swing down the ground because of the shape on the ball and late movement, and with long-off deep Narine gets one but dangerously
into the body from good length on leg stump, Narine goes for a wild swing on the leg side but misses it completely and is hit on the pad outside leg
drops the length short on middle and Raghuvanshi defends it back for one

what elegance and timing! Raghuvanshi is on the move down the pitch to probably negate the swing and he clips it beautifully off his padse for a four all along the ground. Gets an applause from the owner SRK too
and that's just what Narine doesn't want! A short ball into his body and he misses it with a pivot for the pull. Takes it on the body
that's just what Narine wants! Low full toss on the off side and he cracks it away along the ground through the covers for four
angles the short ball into him and Raghuvanshi tucks it to leg for one

that is a one-handed stunner from Avesh Khan! Salt slapped it back to Avesh's left and he had to stretch and go low quickly, and boy he did it just in time for the ball to stick in his palm. One of the catches of this IPL and Riyan Parag can breathe easy now
swings the length ball across the line and that reaches midwicket after a bounce
pitched up to Narine and he whacks it down, but after a bounce to mid-on
nasty reply from Boult with a well-directed short ball that comes into Salt and he takes it on the helmet grille, probably after a thin edge
too full to make it swing and Salt drills that with strong bottom hand and that's beaten mid-off easily for his first four of the night
139.7kmh, much shorter and quicker from Boult and Narine miscues the pull that goes over the umpire
132.2kmh, he makes room yet again and the ball shapes away from him after pitching on middle. Beaten
fuller with inswing on middle and Salt flicks it to mid-on for a quick one

just beats a sprinting mid-on! Salt doesn't middle that pull at all and it's gone high in the air. Midwicket and mid-on go after it with their eyes on the ball but it lands wide of Avesh running back from mid-on
pitched up to end the over, but this is much wider and it beats Narine because he's been backing away
can't pitch it to Narine out there! Right in the slot at 123.6kmh, around middle and he makes just a bit of room to crash it to the long-on boundary for four
that has bounced over Narine and the keeper! That bouncer really troubled Narine and hurried him up too, and the good bounce meant it beat Samson too. Gone for four byes
yes, he bangs it in short and Narine makes room to pull it away but the away movement and the angle beats him
swinging into Salt and he whacks it over square leg. There's protection in the deep
pitched up wide of the crease and Narine flays it in the air for deep point
right on target for the last ball. A length ball on middle with some inswing, he defends to mid-off with a straight bat
swings big on the off side for the ball in the slot on fourth stump, he misses it completely
swinging into the pads and Salt flicks it in the air over the infield easily for two. Off the mark
touch fuller outside off and he drives it into the covers
he has put down a sitter! A tentative push outside off for the length ball with a hint of shape, that has gone straight into Parag's hands at point and he has somehow put it down! Unbelievable
swing into the batter straightaway from back of length on middle, tucked towards midwicket carefully
heaves it into the leg side, gets it past the infield and Royals have pulled off IPL's biggest run chase
gets a high full toss, Buttler thumps it to wide long-off, the throw from Starc is loopy and wide, Buttler somehow cobbles a second. He's exhausted, but somehow gets there.
finds the fielder as he reverse sweeps straight to short third. Good stop by Harshit
width outside off, crashes it to deep point. Keeps strike, so it's another dot ball.
flays this hard to long-off, refuses the single.
dug into the pitch, Buttler goes back and thumps this over long-on. Also gets to his century as the Royals dug out applauds a sensational innings
works it gently into the leg side as they take a quick single.
mistimes a heave into the leg side, they come back for the second as Starc loses his balance as he gets to the ball at deep square
dug in short, Buttler pulls and clears a leaping Starc at deep square! Anticipated the short ball and was ready for it when it arrived. Hit it right off the middle. Flat hit to the bigger boundary.
Harshit Rana may have thought for a second he'd done well to go yorker-length. Buttler uses the depth of the crease to take it on the full and shovel it down the ground to beat long-on.
full toss, belted straight to cover at the edge of the ring. Doesn't take the run
heaved over deep midwicket! Deep into the stands. Buttler stays his ground and picks the bones out of this slower length ball.
sensibly drives to deep cover point for a single. Royals need 28 off 12.
reaches out to scythe this behind square, the keeper has fumbled, this one bursts through his gloves and runs away to the boundary. Five wides wrapped in a gift.

dug in short, Buttler takes on the short ball and manages to get enough bat on it to bisect square leg and short fine. Excellent anticipation from Buttler. This would've been signalled wide had he not got bat on it.
attempts a reverse scoop as Starc slants it full and across, misses.

drilled to long-off, calls for two but they were never going to make it. Boult was very slow in turning around, but in all fairness there was never a second. Boult continued to run nonetheless to get Buttler back on strike. Must say it was an excellent return on the bounce from Iyer to the bowler.
cut away to deep point
slips this full delivery way outside off, left alone. Wide called
full and right into the swinging arc, Buttler clears his front leg and tees off down town to clear the ropes.
swung away to the long-on boundary where Angkrish Raghuvanshi made a stunning attempt in getting to the ball from the ropes, but couldn't hold on.  Tough, tough chance.

sweet revenge as Narine traps him on the pad. Given lbw but Rovman instinctively reviews. Unless he's got some bat on it, looks quite dead. Ball tracking confirms this would've smashed the stumps. Three reds, Rovman goes.
beats him outside off with a carromball that deviates big

That has been bludgeoned! Boy, this guy can hit them clean and far. Narine's scratching his head to wonder what he's done wrong, fact is he didn't. Rovman's quick hands and transfer of weight back made that pull possible. Cleared deep midwicket effortlessly
clears long-off! That's a Rovman special. Narine bowls full and he stays his ground and swings cleanly to comfortably clear the ropes.
steps out and heaves this length ball into the leg side, the ball bisects deep square and deep midwicket. Didn't get holds of that but got enough bat on it.
wide yorker again, squeezed into the gap at sweeper cover. Another 17-run over
the sound that made as it made contact with the bat was sweeeeeet! Bowled into the pitch, sat up for Buttler to swing across the line to clear long-on.
scythed to square third, Russell went yorker-length that time
heaved across the line to long-on
pulled to deep midwicket
picked over fine leg for six! Veers a length ball down leg and Rovman brings his wrists into play superbly as he lends direction to that.
looks to swing this over long-off but gets a thick edge that flies past short third. 17 off that over.
fired full on the stumps, defended back
going wrong with his lines! Fires this full and down leg, Buttler plays a ferocious slog to beat deep backward square leg
slips this skiddy length ball down leg, wid ecalled.
reverse-pulled this time, up and over short third. Picked the bones out of this. Gets to a 36-ball half-century

would you believe it? Chakravarthy has beaten Buttler in the air and off the pitch, but still sees the ball fly away to the boundary. Buttler looks to chip down the track and hack it into the leg side but gets a leading edge that beats short third.
beaten as Buttler attempts an audacious reverse sweep to pick it between point and short third. There's an umpire's review for a stumping, all good there.
rushes him into the defensive stroke again, down to short third
skids one through on a length outside off, jams his bat down quickly as he defends to cover
bowls the carromball on a length outside off, tucked to midwicket
drifts one full on off, Buttler defends back
skids one through on a length on middle, Powell tucks it to square leg
works it down to deep midwicket
full on the stumps, Powell plays back and ends up awkwardly defending.
tucks this down to deep square leg again
rank long hop, Buttler pulls him down to deep square where Starc slides and stops
drifts in a length ball from wide of the crease, worked past midwicket

he's chipped this straight to cover. Hetmyer can't believe what he has just done. The length ball sticks into the pitch, a direct consequence of there being no dew, Hetmyer is through with the shot very early. Soft dismissal.

picks out deep midwicket! Pressure was building, Ashwin looks for the release shot but doesn't time it off the middle as he pulls Chakravarthy's hard length. Excellent catch diving forward from Angkrish Raghuvanshi.
looks to hack this into the leg side, gets a thick inside edge down to long leg
into the blockhole, dug out to point
dug in short, Ashwin looks to ramp it over short third but is beaten by the skid off the pitch
mistimes a heave down to long-on, squirted off a thick inside edge
whips this full toss to wide mid-on, good stop by Starc
slower and fuller outside off, shovelled to long-off
swings for the hills and gets a thick edge that flies past short third to the boundary. Ungainly slog from Ashwin but he'll take the runs
hit hard to long-off

struck on the boot as Buttler attempts a reverse sweep. Impact may have been outside the line. They think for a while and then Iyer signals for a review. Ball tracking confirms as much.  The not out call from Ulhas Gandhe stays.
skids one through on a length, cramps Buttler for room as it drifts in gently, played back to Varun
chipped down to long-on
gets an inside edge onto the pad as he tries to punch through cover
pulled to deep midwicket, Russell brings his right boot out to stop that. Good stop that. Just for a brief second, Russell looked down and in a bit of pain but he's quickly back up on his feet.
bunts it down to long-on
flayed to backward point, excellent stop by Ramandeep moving to his left. Saved a certain boundary
full on leg-stump, worked down to wide long-on
steered straight to point
floats it up nicely outside off and Buttler lofts him over mid-off. Dribbles into the boundary.
lunges forward to defend back off the leading edge, rolls to Narine
mistimes a cut wide of point, turns down the single

spins this down leg, Ashwin beaten as he attempts a tickle. Ashwin doesn't like the wide call and reviews. Ultra edge confirms no spike - didn't flick the pad essentially - so the original decision will have to be reversed. Wide it is.

gets it to spin back in to beat the inside edge as Jurel prods tentatively. May have been struck outside the line. KKR have reviewed the on-field call. Narine was ultra confident in his appeal and ball tracking confirms all three reds, so the original decision is reversed.
cuts straight to point
works this down to wide long-on for a single
length on off, hint of spin back in, Jurel nudges it into the leg side for a single
runs it down to third man to get off the mark

he's got more elevation than distance and Russell takes the steepler at deep midwicket! Harshit rolled his fingers across the team as he bowled length at 113kph, Riyan fetched it from outside off as he attempted to heave this over long-on, didn't time it as well as he would've liked.
slower and fuller on the stumps, tucked wide of square leg.
heaves this slower ball to deep midwicket
short and wide outside off, Riyan stands tall and opens the bat face at the very last moment as he slaps this behind point. Dismissed!
disdain and nonchalance says Manjrekar, words I had in mind too. Length ball angling into the pads and Riyan whips him over deep backward square leg. Incredible bat speed
tight line on off, pushed to short cover
driven to wide long-off as they jog the single
nudged into the leg side, off the pad. Tried to work it gently into the gap
bunts it to the man coming in from long-on, Starc's beaten comfortably as they steal the second
drifts a length ball down leg, Riyan swungs and misses, keeper fumbles as the ball rolls to short fine leg.
sticks into the surface as he bowls length on middle and leg, worked neatly into the gap at deep midwicket
shortish and drifting into the pads, tickled to short fine leg
drilled through the off-side to bisect cover and mid-off. In the slot for Riyan and he nailed it.

that's incredible wrist work and forearm strength from Riyan! Vaibhav bowls hard length on middle-and-off, Riyan picks the length early and allows his wrists to come into play as he picks it over midwicket. This is sensational. Stillness at the crease the key to make that shot possible.
swung away to deep square leg. Lucky to get away with that rank long hop
rank high full toss - they call those rosogullas in this part of the world - and Buttler says 'thank you' as he thumps it over long-on.
struck on the pad as he tries to hack this over midwicket. The angle would've taken it down leg. Unfortunately for KKR, Harshit has overstepped and a free-hit is coming up
driven to cover where Angkrish throws himself to his left to save a couple of runs at the very least
short of length and angling into middle and leg, Riyan stays still this time as he wrists this behind square. Beat long leg comfortably.
toe-ends a flick to short fine, quick single stolen
gets a leading edge past short third for four! Riyan's looking to back away again as he tries to work this to the leg side, the ball flies off the edge to beat Chakravarthy.
slower ball gone wrong, slips it down leg and it's called wide. Riyan backed away, Harshit tried to follow him and lost his radar
makes room to manufacture something but is beaten again. Was looking to slash over point.
excellent bumper outside off, Riyan looks to take him on first up by trying to fetch a pull from outside off but is beaten for pace.

you can't keep that man out! Sunil Narine with an excellent catch at mid-on as Samson goes. Harshit bowls hard length, this one gets Samson high on the bat as he attempts to loft it over the infield, doesn't control that and Narine takes a good catch moving a few steps backwards before timing his jump to perfection.
gets a thickish inside edge wide of midwicket
driven straight back, good stop off his own bowling.
walks across to access the ball, the late movement means Buttler's attempted flick gets a leading edge as it rolls to point
tight line on off-stump, defended back
punched down to long-on as they jog the single
calculative batting at its very best! Samson shuffled across to off and picks this length ball over midwicket. Delightful wrist work.
sweet connection! Shows the full face of the bat as he lofts imperiously over mid-on

dropped and Chakravarthy is having a tough time. Loose drive from Samson away from the body, gets a thick edge, flies comfortably to Chakravarthy who makes a right royal mess at short third. Hit his palm and bobbled out.
and he comes into play straightaway as Buttler drives to sweeper cover
flayed through the covers! Buttler uses the width to wallop that between the two fielders. Pinged off the middle.
dug in short but this is way off the radar down leg, wide called as Buttler attempts to pull but can't reach the ball
punches this length delivery straight to Russell at point
slips this too far wide outside off, wide called. Once again, no movement back in for Starc
that's bludgeoned through the covers! Starc goes full on off-stump searching for late in-swing but there isn't much and Buttler simply blasts that through the line. No one moved.
gets a thick edge down to square third man
gets a juicy full toss first up and he bunts it to mid-off for a single

gets his revenge as Vaibhav belts out a roar! Comes back superbly with a full delivery on off, this shape away late and Jaiswal is a tad late as he swings through without any feet movement, gets a thick edge and Venky Iyer pouches it nice and easy at slip.
just eludes Chakravarthy at mid-on! Jasiwal looked to go over the infield, and is lucky to get enough elevation. Didn't middle it by any means.
clobbered! Clears his front leg, gets under the length and swings through to clear long-off.
full on middle, Jaiswal makes room and squeezes the drive straight to cover
full outside off, good shape back in as Buttler turns it to mid-on
streaky but they all count! Jaiswal is cramped for room as he tries to force that short of length delivery through cover, ends up getting a thick edge to the third man boundary.
beaten as he swings through the line to go over cover again
thumped over cover! Used the width and lofted it through the line without a trace of fear.
looks to slash that over point but is beaten for pace. Lost his shape
length on middle and leg at 146kph, tapped down to mid-on for a quick single
hint of movement off the seam as he bowls length on off, Jaiswal gets a thick edge down to third man
sprays it too far wide outside off, collected by Salt in front of first slip
